title: The document is a tree

blocks.promptMd: `document.querySelector("h1")` returns the tag as a string.
blocks.explainMd: It returns an element node, or null if nothing matches. The HTML string is not the return value.

hintLadder.md: Find the heading node. Do not rewrite the HTML file as a string.
The plate should read Signal desk after you change the node.

description: The page is a tree of nodes, not a pile of text.
